### Analytics {slug: cold-email-agent/campaigns/managing-campaigns/analytics}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Cold Email Agent", then open a campaign; Analytics is its default view.
- "Leads Contacted": unique people who got at least one email, capped at leads uploaded.
- "Replies": reply rate vs leads contacted. "Include auto replies" is on by default (counts out-of-office); off counts manual replies only.
- "Positive Replies": AI-classified genuine interest, with a target (Healthy PRR from the "Options" tab; podcast default 1%). Out-of-office, not interested and unsubscribes don't count.
- "Booked Calls": % of positive replies; target default 25%, set on "Options".
- Trend chart: "Contacted" is emails sent per day including follow-ups (not unique leads), plus "Replied" and "Positive". Ranges: Last 7 days to All time.
- Per-step tables: "Total" row plus one row per variant, with an enable/disable toggle. Columns: "Sent", "Replied", "Positive Responses", "Booked Calls". All per-email, not per-lead. Disabling stops future use; history stays. The agent acts only after a variant passes the "Minimum Threshold" of sends.
- Zero replies after 1,000+ sends: likely deliverability. Check bounce rate on the "Leads" tab (auto-pauses at 5%), inbox health in Email Accounts (below 80% is a problem), and send yourself a test.
- No activity for 3+ days: check campaign status, sending schedule on "Options", inbox health, Attention Needed banners.

Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Cold Email Agent", open a campaign, then click the "AI Agent" tab.

Recommended: "Optimize email variants" on Run automatically; "Add more leads" (can spend lead credits), "Start new campaigns", "Pause underperforming campaigns" (only alongside a replacement campaign) on Ask first. Keep "Run actions when approvals expire" off.

- Approvals expire after 24 hours. Buttons: "Approve", "Reject", "Review later", "Continue" (needs lead-source filters or CSV), "Top up". Approval that would disable every variant is blocked. CSVs use no credits but count toward contact capacity.
- Re-enable variants on the "Sequences" tab.
- Recommendation but no action: switch off, mode Ask first or Off, or waiting for data or lead source.

### Acquisity AI Lead Search {slug: cold-email-agent/campaigns/managing-campaigns/scrape-leads}
Get here: New campaign wizard, "Lead source" step, "Acquisity Lead Database". Existing campaign: "Cold Email Agent", the campaign, "Leads" tab, "Add Leads", "Lead Database", "Open Lead Scraper".
- Describe a market in "AI Search" or set filters manually (job titles, location, industries, keywords, employees). Defaults: 1-50 employees, United States.
- Finds companies by market category, not exact ICP. Use a CSV for that.
- Preview companies. Keywords use OR logic. If 3+ of 3-5 checked companies fit badly, remove the keyword from "Company Keywords" or add it to "Excluded Keywords".
- Click "Next": import 500 by default, minimum 100. Click "Confirm".
- Top up: "Settings" > "Billing" > "Credit Balances", or "Settings" > "Cold Email Agent" > "Feature Credits".
- 1 credit = 1 verified lead. Previews and CSV uploads are free. Emails are verified live, so the final count can be lower.
- Standalone: owned leads are filtered out. With a connected sending platform, duplicates still cost credits.
- "Launch campaigns automatically once the setup is complete" is on by default. Off gives a Draft. Disabled for "Upload Your Own".
- Capacity: Growth 5,000 campaign leads per organization; other plans often 25,000 per provider workspace. At the cap, export CSV from the "Leads" tab, then delete leads.
- Reuse filters: campaign "Options" tab, bottom (AI Lead Search campaigns only).
- Avoid over 5,000 leads per campaign.

### Buying inboxes {slug: cold-email-agent/email-accounts/buying-inboxes}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Cold Email Agent", then "Email Accounts", then "Add New Inboxes".
- "Connect Existing Accounts" is disabled (Coming Soon).
- "Pre-warmed Inboxes" card: Google, ready day one, platform picks domain, 3 inboxes per domain. Click "Continue", pick domains (filter with "Search from pre-warmed accounts", "Load more"; review "Selected Domains"), then "Next".
- "Done-For-You Setup" card: search a domain (.com/.net/.org filters; "taken" ones can't be chosen), "Next", then add exactly 3 inboxes per domain (sender name, username, domain dropdown, "Add"). Otherwise "Must add 3 inboxes for ..." appears. More than 3 per domain is unsupported; buy more domains.
- DFY inboxes show an orange flame for about 2 weeks. Don't attach them to campaigns until it turns green. Sending then ramps to 35 emails/day.
- "Forwarding Domain" field at checkout. If empty, "Place Order" opens "Confirm Domain Forwarding" ("Cancel" or "Continue Without Forwarding").
- Promo code: "Apply". A checkout countdown returns domains to the pool when it expires.
- Inboxes bill monthly, domains yearly, renewing on the 15th. Inboxes and registered domains are not refundable.
- Ready when Status is Active, flame green, health score 80%+.
- SPF/DKIM/DMARC are set up automatically within minutes.
- Banners: "Processing domains...", "Provisioning domains (X/Y)...", "Provisioning complete!", "Provisioning requires attention". Retries every ~30 minutes for 24 hours; after that contact support with domain names. Provisioned pre-warmed domains are usable now. If none provision, "Order Cancelled" and an automatic refund (a few business days). "N mailboxes could not be retried": contact support. The banner's X hides it permanently.
- Error status after purchase: wait 30 minutes, refresh, then contact support. DFY registration can take up to 24 hours.

### Billing & Credits {slug: workspace-settings/billing}
Get here: "Settings" > "Billing"
- Owners only. No free tier. New workspaces start with 0 credits.
- Lead credits: 1 per verified lead from AI Lead Search. Uploads and sending use none.
- Credits never expire. Recurring packs refill to pack amount. "Buy More" for packs.
- "Manage Billing": invoices. "Open" means unpaid. "Void" and "Uncollectible" mean not charged. Only "Paid" was collected.
- "Cancel Subscription": access lasts until period end.
- If all renewal retries fail, the subscription cancels. Click "Enable Acquisity" to resubscribe.
- Pre-warmed domain: 3 inboxes fixed. Buy at "Cold Email Agent" > "Email Accounts" > "Add New Inboxes". Ready in 30 to 60 minutes.
